## For a new design

- [ ] `src/designs/<name>.ts`, added to `src/designs/index.ts`
- [ ] `npm test` passes and the new snapshot is committed
- [ ] Checked in the demo (`/demo/?design=<name>`) in light and dark mode and at 24 px
- [ ] Screenshot of the demo grid below
- [ ] The art is my own work, released under the MIT licence

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] No snapshot of an existing design changed (that would redraw people's avatars)
